# Tailwind CSS v4 — canonical docs

> NOTE: As of this download date (2026-07-25), Tailwind does **not** publish an
> `llms.txt` file. `https://tailwindcss.com/llms.txt` and
> `https://tailwindcss.com/docs/llms.txt` both return HTTP 404.
>
> Use the canonical documentation pages below instead. Append nothing special —
> Tailwind's docs pages are readable directly. Fetch one page at a time.

## Core (v4)
- Docs home — https://tailwindcss.com/docs
- Upgrade guide (v3 → v4) — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/upgrade-guide
- Installation (Vite) — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/using-vite
- Theme / design tokens (@theme) — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/theme
- Functions & directives (@import, @theme, @utility, @variant, @custom-variant, @plugin, @source, @apply, @reference) — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives
- Adding custom styles (custom utilities, arbitrary values) — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/adding-custom-styles
- Colors — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/colors
- Dark mode — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/dark-mode
- Responsive design — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/responsive-design
- Hover, focus & other states — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/hover-focus-and-other-states
- Detecting classes in source files (@source) — https://tailwindcss.com/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files

## Machine-readable alternative
- Tailwind's docs are open source on GitHub if a local corpus is needed:
  https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.com
